newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end higher in quiet half day trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end higher in quiet half day trade.

text.p: Swedish shares ended slightly higher in quiet half day trade on Wednesday.
The market closed at 1100 GMT ahead of an Ascension Day holiday on Thursday.
The exchange's general index rose 0.26 percent to 2,744.92 in turnover of 2.84 billion crowns.
"It's been a fairly typical half day with quiet trade in general," a trader said.
Telecoms group Ericsson and car safety equipment company Autoliv supported the index by gaining. Ericsson rose four to 262.5 and Autoliv jumped 7.5 to 288.5.
Autoliv Inc. benefited from players adjusting index funds after the merger between Autoliv and a unit of U.S. Morton.
But drugs major Astra dropped four crowns to 315.5 after closing lower in New York than in Stockholm a day earlier.
Investment company Incentive surged 35 to 565 as investors gave a nod to its acquisition of Vivra. Rumours about analysts having target prices of 600 crowns for the share also helped.
Forestry shares were hurt by the weaker dollar but AssiDoman bucked negative trends and rose five to 213 crowns.
